L98:   * Generally, the PIT applies to the income of the approved applicant and their partner if they have a partner
L99:   * If the parents are separated or divorced, determine who the approved applicant is and apply the PIT to that parent (and their partner, if applicable)

L106: 【88†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】
L107:   * Update 【52†PIT Parent Selection (NPPS) screen】. Ensure parent/guardian Customer Reference Numbers and Tax File Numbers are recorded
L108:   * Go to 【53†PIT Sibling Selection (NPSS) screen】. All siblings who have at least one parent in common and are linked to that parent will be displayed here
L109:   * Check the details of the siblings to see if the children are contributing to the family pool on the following screens:

L113:   * If there has been a change in parent/guardian circumstances, see 【55†Table 3 > Step 1】

L118: 【89†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】A PIT exemption applies if:
L119:   * the applicant or their partner:
L120:     * receives a qualifying payment (except during an 【56†employment income nil rate period】 or if they receive the income support payment entirely as a 【57†Home Equity Access Scheme】 loan)
L121:     * holds a Health Care Card (HCC) issued to families in receipt of the maximum rate Family Tax Benefit (FTB) Part A
L122:     * is in long term receipt of JobSeeker Payment (JSP), or
L123:   * the student is in a State authorised foster care arrangement and their carer does not receive a foster care allowance
L124: Does a PIT exemption apply?

L127:   * No, see 【59†Table 1 > Step 1】

L143: In all other cases, check that the Household Income (NHI) screen displays the appropriate exemption reason in the PIT Exempt Rsn: field. If the details do not match, the parent's record may need updating. Some PIT exemption reasons will need manual coding. See 【62†Circumstances when the Parental Income Test (PIT) does not apply】.

L148: ### Collecting and coding combined parental income
L149: 
L150: Table 2
L151: 
L152: Step
L153: 
L154: Action

L157: 
L158: Combined Parental income details + Read more ...

L160: 【92†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】Collect information on the parent's income for the base tax year from either a new claim (SY040) or from the FAO Income for Previous Year (FIPY) screen of the applicant's record.
L161: Note: if the parent has any of the following income estimates recorded on their family assistance record, then the actual income information for these income components must be obtained from the parent as actuals are not obtained for Family Tax Benefit/Child Care Benefit/Child Care Subsidy reconciliation purposes:
L162: 
L163:   * Tax Exempt Foreign income (FEF screen)
L164:   * Foreign Income (FFI screen)
L165:   * Tax Free Pension/Benefit (FTF screen)
L166:   * Deductible Child Maintenance Expenditure (FDM screen)
L167: 
L168: If:
L169:   * base tax year income details are supplied and the applicant is PIT exempt, then it may be coded
L170:   * base tax year income is recorded and there is a change in the PIT exempt status, the system will adjust the rate accordingly
L171:   * there is no record of base tax year income details a request for information will be issued
L172: 
L173: Have parents completed:
L174:   * all boxes in the parental income question of the SY040 for the financial year ending in the year before study, and
L175:   * provided details of any other dependent children in the family for whom various means tested payments is being, or will be claimed, and has suitable proof of income been provided?
L176:   * Yes, 【63†go to Step 2】
L177:   * No, Basic Boarding Allowance (BA) may be paid pending receipt of the requested information. Issue request for information for the base tax year using Q760 - request for information, incomplete claim
L178: 2
L179: 
L180: Record income details for the base tax year + Read more ...
L181: 
L182: 【93†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】Record income details for the parent(s) for the base tax year on the Household Income and Assets (NHI) screen in Customer First.
L183: Record the Date of Effect: field as 1 January and the Financial Year Ending: field as the base tax year. Complete the following fields as appropriate:
L184:   * taxable income
L185: Where the parent's actual income is $nil, code $0 and the system will automatically populate $1 of taxable income to allow calculation of ABA entitlement. Where auto population of $1 is inappropriate, leave this field blank and the system will automatically populate $0 and not calculate ABA entitlement
L186:   * overseas income
L187: Convert the overseas income figure to Australian dollars by dividing the figure by the applicable conversion rate
L188:   * maintenance paid
L189:   * passive business/investment losses: (for example, negative gearing)
L190:   * reportable superannuation contributions
L191:   * 【64†tax free pensions and benefits】 (applies from 1 July 2017 onward)
L192:   * exempt reportable fringe benefits
L193:   * other reportable fringe benefits
L194: If other reportable fringe benefits have been received, enter the amount shown on the payment summary. The system will calculate the adjusted fringe benefits figure.
L195: 
L196: Complete other fields as appropriate.
L197: 
L198: 3
L199: 
L200: Details of other dependent children + Read more ...
L201: 
L202: The applicant should have provided details of any other dependent children in the family (siblings of the student) for whom one of the following means tested payments is being, or will be, claimed:
L203:   * AIC Additional Boarding Allowance (ABA)
L204:   * Youth Allowance (YA)
L205:   * ABSTUDY Living Allowance and/or means tested component of School Fees Allowance
L206:   * Sibling(s) who meet the definition of an FTB child aged 0-15 or 16-19 years and in full-time secondary study
L207:   * Sibling(s) who are regular care children and whose parent(s) have verified rent recorded
L208: To check that the sibling information (if relevant) is already recorded or needs updating, see 【65†Assessing and coding claims for Assistance for Isolated Children (AIC)】.
L209: 
L210: 4
L211: 
L212: Current Income assessment or Reverse Current Income + Read more ...
L213: 【94†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】Are the parents applying for a Current Income assessment or is a Reverse Current Income assessment required?
L214: 
L215: For help, see 【66†Determining the appropriate tax year for the Parental Income Test (PIT) for Youth Allowance (YA), ABSTUDY and Assistance for Isolated Children (AIC) Scheme】.
L216:   * Yes, an AIC Current Tax Year Assessment (SY042) is required. If this has not been completed, ask the parents to complete an SY042 or issue request for information (Q760). When received, 【67†assess SY042】. Basic Boarding Allowance (BA) can be paid pending this assessment
L217:   * No, 【68†go to Step 5】
L218: 
L219: 5
L220: 
L221: Finalise activity + Read more ...
L222: 【95†Image: Processing Team: Typically done by specialised processing teams in a service centre or Smart Centre. Unless otherwise stated, staff may complete this step if they are trained.】Finalise activity on the Assessment Results (AR) screen and record details on a DOC.
L223: 
L224: The system automatically calculates ABA entitlement based on details that have been recorded.
L225: The amount of ABA subject to the PIT is determined by the amount of annual boarding charges. These must exceed the maximum rate of Basic Boarding Allowance less $250 for incidentals for any ABA to be paid, subject to the PIT.
L226: 
L227: See 【45†Eligibility for Assistance for Isolated Children (AIC) Scheme Boarding Allowance (BA/ABA)】 to manually calculate this amount.
L228: If a PIT exemption does not apply, the ABA entitlement is affected by the amount of combined parental income over the Parental Income Free Area (PIFA). For the Parental income free area, see 【69†Assistance for Isolated Children (AIC) - Parental Income Test (PIT)】.
L229: The amount of combined parental income affecting the student will be reduced if there are 【70†siblings in receipt of a PIT tested payment】 or a sibling who is a 【71†FTB child】 or Regular Care Child. The family taper of 20% is applied to the student's share of the parental income above the threshold, i.e. the rate of payment is reduced by 20 cents for each dollar of the student's share of their parents' affecting income.
L230: 
L231: For current AIC rate information, see AIC category in 【49†Rates and Thresholds】.
L232: From 1 January 2017 to 31 December 2018, a Maintenance Income Test may have applied. The Parental Income Test Reduction Amount (PITRA) and the Maintenance Income Test Notional Reduction (MITNR) are automatically calculated and compared to determine the ABA entitlement. For historical information, see Table 2 in 【72†Maintenance Income Test (MIT) for ABSTUDY and Youth Allowance (YA).】

L269: Note: Service Officers must check the record of the applicant to ensure the death action has been completed.

L276:

L278:   * eligibility is reassessed from the date of the change in circumstance
L279:   * the income test only assesses the applicant's income
L280: 
L281: Note: a Mod S is not required if the customer's parent(s)/guardian(s) are partnered and not receiving an income support payment.
L282: 
L283: 【78†Go to Step 5】.

L288: 
L289: If the applicant gains a partner (for example, remarrying or beginning a de facto relationship):
L290:   * eligibility is reassessed from the date of change of circumstance
L291:   * the income test uses the combined income of the applicant and the new partner
L292: 
L293: 【79†Go to Step 6】.

L296: 
L297: Ending PIT link details of the parent/guardian + Read more ...
L298: Update the PIT Parent Selection (NPPS) screen where appropriate, ensuring relevant siblings are linked on the PIT Sibling Selection (NPSS) screen. See 【52†Creating, updating and ending Parental Income Test (PIT) links with dependent student, Australian Apprentice and job seeker recipients or claimants】.
L299: 
L300: For parents that have separated or become widowed:
L301:   * Unlink the parent using the NPPS screen
L302:   * Navigate to the Assets (NHI) screen within the same activity
L303:   * Check if there are any previous estimates for the unlinked parent
L304:   * If any estimates remain, update to actual
L305:   * Record details in a DOC
L306: 
L307: Procedure ends here.
L308:

L310: 
L311: Code details of the parent(s)/guardian(s) + Read more ...
L312: 
L313: If the customer is able to provide sufficient information at the time of contact:
L314:   * Update 【52†PIT Parent Selection (NPPS) screen】
L315:   * Ensure parent/guardian Customer Reference Numbers (CRN) and Tax File Numbers (TFN) are recorded
L316:   * Record details in a DOC
